lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs arranged in four visible vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, with inter-spot spacing approximately three times the diameter of individual centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary circular blobs, creating a regular grid where blobs function as high-luminance nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent linear features run horizontally along the upper flank, defined by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity upper edges to shadowed lower boundaries.
